$comment: The four mock banking roles of the proposal (notes/_PROPOSAL-apollo-mcp-2026-09-26-v2.html § Four mock roles), as the build spec fixes them (notes/_lanes/312/C/SPEC-launchpad-day-one.md § 6). Best guesses, mock only (s305-D46). A 'mock role' here is a banking role; it never mixes with a 'provides role' of knowledge/roles.json. Written by #313 lane C4.

limit.$source: spec § 6: payments awaiting approval up to the mock limit of £500,000; anything above needs a second approver

corporate-treasurer.sees: own company's accounts, all entities; payments awaiting approval up to the mock limit of £500,000; anything above needs a second approver

relationship-manager.sees: own book of client companies, balances at summary level only; no payment detail; cannot prepare approvals

operations-analyst.sees: payments in their region's queue, by stage; repairs and exceptions in full; no balances; cannot prepare approvals

auditor.sees: the records of screens sent and decisions made; no live balances or payments; cannot call anything that prepares or changes

supplies.$comment: [spec] § 7: which tool supplies which data shape. A data item's shape must be one its tool supplies (selftest T4.4b). `dashboard` supplying the one-state shape is this lane's [spec] addition: the cut-off status is derived by the server from the clock (spec § 6, 'time triggers act on what is shown'), so the only grant it needs is the dashboard call itself.
